caption: The drawing features a stylized emblem centrally placed within a square format. The background of the square is primarily red with a dark border. Inside the square, there is a large, rounded yellow oval bordered by a thick green outline. Within this yellow oval is a red heart shape, oriented upright, and a green cord or vine is wrapped horizontally around its middle. At the top of the heart is a small, dark cross. Surrounding the heart within the yellow oval, there are short red lines radiating outward, resembling rays. The entire composition is centered on an off-white or light beige background, with no additional objects or elements outside the main emblem.
title: Plate 50: Sacred Heart: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
